name: Bomi Namaitdeon Jari
source: Our heroine, Yeon Ha-Jin returns to school after her first spring break after entering high school. She leads a relatively normal life. However, in the this time, a series of events happened that she has yet to realize. Should she hold old relationships dear or follow the string of new encounters and build new bond? With this the story starts with our heroine Yuen Ha-Jin...
translation: 女主角延河真在升入高中后的第一个春假结束后重返校园，继续过着相对平凡的生活。然而就在这段时间，一连串她尚未察觉的事情已经发生。她应该珍视过去的关系，还是循着接踵而来的新邂逅，建立新的羁绊？女主角延河真的故事由此开始……
